library(dplyr)
solve <- function(x, ...) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  y <- x |> sapply(\(v) v^2) |> sum()
  if (y > 10) { return(y) } else y
}
df <- data.frame(a = 1:3, b = c("x", "y", NA))
df %>% filter(!is.na(b)) %>% mutate(c = a * 2) -> out
for (i in seq_len(nrow(out))) print(out[i, "c"])
m <- matrix(1:4, 2); m[1, ] <- 0L; names(df)[[2]] <- "bb"
